light.morning: Morning in late October, soft cool overcast daylight, a little mist low over the grass.
light.late morning: Late morning in late October, bright soft overcast daylight.
light.afternoon: Afternoon in late October, soft low sun through the window, clear and bright, not golden.
light.late afternoon: Late afternoon in late October, low soft sun slanting through the window onto the table, clear and bright, everything clearly visible.

outfits.walk: a long oatmeal wool coat over a cream chunky-knit cardigan, a rust knitted scarf, dark-green rubber boots
outfits.kitchen: a cream chunky-knit cardigan with the sleeves pushed to the forearm over a white linen blouse, a faded olive linen apron
outfits.table: a cream chunky-knit cardigan over a white linen blouse

places.garden: a thatched cottage with a big walled kitchen garden in late October: old red-brick walls, raised wooden beds, bean wigwams of dry brown vines, a small glass greenhouse, two old apple trees with windfall apples lying in the long grass beneath, a gravel path, the thatched cottage with a sage-green back door
places.kitchen: a small plain cottage kitchen: a white butler sink under a small-paned window onto the garden, a pale oak worktop, a sage-green range cooker, cream wall tiles, one wooden shelf with a few plain glass jars and an old green tin
places.table: a small round pale-oak table by the kitchen window, two plain wooden chairs, the walled garden outside the small-paned window, a plain lamp with a linen shade on the sill

garden.brief: The walled kitchen garden empty, nobody in it, seen from the back door: old red-brick wall, raised beds, bean wigwams of dry brown vines, the small greenhouse, an old apple tree with windfall apples in the long grass, the gravel path. Soft overcast daylight.

kitchen.brief: The kitchen empty, nobody in it, seen from the doorway: the butler sink under the small-paned window, the oak worktop, the sage-green range cooker, a wooden shelf with glass jars and an old green tin. Bright soft daylight.

table.brief: The small round oak table by the kitchen window, empty, two chairs, the walled garden outside the window, a plain lamp with a linen shade on the sill. Soft daylight.

the basket.brief: A round willow basket with a handle, lined with a faded blue-and-white checked cloth, empty, standing on a pale oak worktop. Soft daylight.

the tin.brief: An old round recipe tin, faded dark green with worn paint at the edges and a lid, standing on a pale oak worktop, closed. Soft daylight.

Pip.brief: Pip the cat sitting upright on a pale oak kitchen floor, looking slightly to the side, full body in view, soft daylight.

beats.shot: Wide empty view of the walled kitchen garden in the morning mist, no woman and no person anywhere: the old brick wall, bean wigwams, the greenhouse, two apple trees with red and yellow windfall apples scattered in the long grass.
Ellie seen from behind at the sage-green back door of the thatched cottage, the empty willow basket on her arm, pulling the door closed.
beats.move: She pulls the door closed with a soft click of the latch and turns toward the garden; the camera stays locked off.

beats.shot: Ellie seen from behind, small in the frame, walking slowly along the gravel path of the walled garden past the bean wigwams, the basket on her arm.
beats.move: She walks slowly away along the path with soft crunching steps; the plants and the camera stay perfectly still.

beats.shot: Close-up of the gravel path edge: her dark-green rubber boots stepping slowly through wet long grass scattered with fallen apples.
beats.move: Her boots take two slow steps through the grass with a soft swish; the apples stay where they lie.

beats.shot: Close-up of red-and-yellow windfall apples lying in the long wet grass under an old apple tree, a few brown leaves among them.
Close-up of the long grass under the apple tree: her hand in an oatmeal wool coat sleeve picks up one red-and-yellow windfall apple.
beats.move: Her hand slowly lifts the apple out of the grass; drops of dew fall from it.

beats.shot: Close-up of her hands in oatmeal wool coat sleeves turning a windfall apple over to look at its bruised side, then rubbing it on the coat.
beats.move: She turns the apple slowly and rubs its skin with her thumb.

beats.shot: Top-down close-up of the willow basket lined with blue-and-white checked cloth standing in the long grass outdoors, three windfall apples in it; her hand lays one more apple in.
beats.move: Her hand lays the apple in the basket and draws back out of frame; the others stay where they are.

beats.shot: Ellie seen from the side, crouching in the grass under an old apple tree, her head bowed, the basket beside her, gathering apples from the grass.
beats.move: She slowly reaches for another apple and lifts it, head bowed; the camera stays still.

beats.shot: Close-up of a blackbird hopping in the long grass beside a fallen apple with a hole pecked in it.
beats.move: The blackbird pecks the apple once and lifts its head; the grass and the apple stay still.

beats.shot: Close-up of her hands in oatmeal wool sleeves holding two apples together and tapping them gently against each other to hear if they are sound.
beats.move: She taps the apples together twice with a soft knock and sets one in the basket.

beats.shot: Close-up of an old brick wall of the garden in soft light, a late red apple still hanging on a bare espaliered branch against the bricks.
Ellie seen from behind under the old apple tree, reaching up to one of the last red apples on a branch.
beats.move: She reaches up slowly and twists the apple off the branch; the branch springs back a little; the camera stays locked off.

beats.shot: Close-up of a small glass greenhouse door standing open, tomato plants gone brown inside, a wooden crate of apples on its floor.
beats.move: Only a thin drift of mist moves past the door; nothing else moves and no one walks in.

beats.shot: Close-up of her hands in oatmeal wool sleeves brushing a few wet leaves off a windfall apple over the basket.
beats.move: She brushes the apple slowly with her fingers and drops it into the basket with a soft thud.

beats.shot: Ellie seen from behind, walking back along the gravel path toward the cottage's back door, the full basket on her arm.
beats.move: She walks slowly away along the path; the mist and the plants stay still and the camera does not follow.

beats.shot: Close-up of the willow basket lined with blue-and-white checked cloth standing on the stone step of the sage-green back door, full of red-and-yellow windfall apples.

Wide view of the bright kitchen with nobody in it: the full willow basket on the oak worktop by the butler sink, a wooden shelf with glass jars and an old green tin, the garden through the small-paned window.
Top-down close-up of the oak worktop: her hands in cream knit sleeves empty the basket, setting windfall apples one by one on the checked cloth.
beats.move: Her hands set the last few apples down slowly; each apple stays where she puts it.

beats.shot: Ellie seen from behind at the wooden shelf of the kitchen, reaching up for the old green tin.
beats.move: She lifts the old tin down from the shelf with both hands; the camera stays locked off.

beats.shot: Close-up of the old faded-green tin on the oak worktop: her hands in cream knit sleeves lift off its lid.
beats.move: The lid lifts off slowly with a small metallic scrape; the tin stays on the worktop.

beats.shot: Close-up inside the open old green tin: a stack of yellowed handwritten recipe cards, soft with age; her fingers walk through the cards.
beats.move: Her fingertips tick slowly through the edges of the cards and stop at one.

beats.shot: Top-down close-up of one yellowed handwritten recipe card titled 'Apple Cake' in faded blue-ink handwriting, a short list of lines under it and a small brown stain in the corner, lying on the oak worktop; her fingertip rests beside it.
beats.move: Her fingertip slowly slides along under the lines of handwriting; the card stays still.

beats.shot: Close-up of her hand in a cream knit sleeve propping the recipe card upright against a glass jar on the worktop.
beats.move: She leans the card against the jar and straightens it with one finger; the card stays still.

beats.shot: Close-up of the recipe card propped against a glass jar on the oak worktop, faded blue handwriting, a brown stain, soft window light, the apples blurred behind.
Close-up of the butler sink under the window: her hands in cream knit sleeves rinse a windfall apple under a thin stream of cold tap water.
beats.move: Water runs over the apple and a little earth washes away slowly into the sink.

beats.shot: Top-down close-up of a wooden board with apples that are already peeled and cored and cut into pale thick slices, heaped in a white bowl; her hand pushes a few slices in.
beats.move: Her hand slowly sweeps the pale slices together into the bowl.

beats.shot: Close-up of a long curl of red apple peel already lying in a coil on the oak worktop, beside a small white bowl of pale apple slices.
beats.move: A thin wisp of steam from the kettle drifts across the back of the frame; nothing else moves.

beats.shot: Close-up of her hands in cream knit sleeves sprinkling cinnamon from a small tin over the white bowl of pale apple slices.
beats.move: Brown cinnamon falls slowly onto the slices in a soft cloud.

beats.shot: Close-up of her fingers turning the apple slices in the white bowl with a wooden spoon so the cinnamon coats them, a squeeze of lemon on top.
beats.move: The spoon turns the slices slowly; they stay pale with brown specks of cinnamon.

beats.shot: Close-up of Pip the cat sitting on the kitchen floor by the range cooker, watching up toward the worktop.
beats.move: Pip blinks slowly and his tail tip curls once; the kitchen stays still.

beats.shot: Ellie seen from the side at the window worktop, head bowed, reading the recipe card propped against the jar, one hand resting on the worktop.
beats.move: She reads for a moment and slowly nods once; the camera stays still.

beats.shot: Close-up of the oak worktop in soft afternoon light, laid out ready: a white mixing bowl, a bag of flour, a bowl of pale sugar, a block of butter on a saucer, three brown eggs.
Top-down close-up of a white mixing bowl: her hand in a cream knit sleeve drops a block of soft pale butter into it.
beats.move: The butter lands in the bowl with a soft thud and her hand draws back.

beats.shot: Tight close-up of the white mixing bowl on the oak worktop: her one hand in a cream chunky-knit cardigan sleeve pushed up to the forearm pours pale sugar from a small bowl onto the soft butter. Only that hand and forearm are in the frame.
beats.move: The sugar pours slowly in a thin stream onto the butter.

beats.shot: Close-up of her hand in a cream knit sleeve beating butter and sugar together with a wooden spoon in the white bowl, the mixture pale and creamy.
beats.move: The wooden spoon beats slowly round the bowl with a soft squelch; the mixture stays pale.

beats.shot: Close-up of her hand cracking a brown egg on the rim of the white bowl of creamy pale butter and sugar.
beats.move: The egg cracks and the yolk drops slowly into the bowl.

beats.shot: Close-up of the white bowl: a hand whisks the egg into the creamy pale mixture with a metal balloon whisk.
beats.move: The whisk circles the bowl and the mixture turns smooth and pale yellow with a soft rhythmic sound.

beats.shot: Ellie seen from behind at the oak worktop, head bowed over the white bowl, whisking steadily with her right arm.
beats.move: Her arm whisks slowly round the bowl, her shoulders moving a little; the camera stays locked off.

beats.shot: Close-up of a sieve held over the white bowl: her hand taps the sieve and white flour falls through it.
beats.move: Flour drifts slowly down through the sieve into the batter in a soft cloud.

beats.shot: Close-up of a white mixing bowl: her hand folds the flour into the pale yellow batter with a large metal spoon.
beats.move: The spoon folds the batter slowly over itself until the flour disappears.

beats.shot: Tight close-up of the white mixing bowl on the oak worktop: her one hand in a cream chunky-knit cardigan sleeve pushed up to the forearm pours a splash of milk from a little cream jug into the thick pale batter. Only that hand and forearm are in the frame.
beats.move: The milk pours slowly and the batter loosens.

beats.shot: Close-up of the white mixing bowl of smooth thick pale-yellow cake batter on the oak worktop, a wooden spoon resting in it, soft afternoon window light.
Close-up of her finger scooping a little thick batter from the white bowl on the wooden spoon.
beats.move: Thick batter slides slowly off the lifted spoon back into the bowl in a ribbon.

beats.shot: Close-up of a small bowl of dark-brown sugar with a spoonful lifted out and scattered over a plate.
beats.move: The sugar falls slowly in a loose brown sprinkle.

beats.shot: Close-up of her hands in cream knit sleeves folding the pale cinnamon apple slices from the small white bowl into the batter.
beats.move: She folds the apple slices through the batter slowly with the spoon.

beats.shot: Close-up of the recipe card propped against the glass jar, faded handwriting, her fingertip tapping one line.
beats.move: Her fingertip taps the line once and lifts away; the card stays still.

beats.shot: Close-up of the oak worktop in soft afternoon light: a round cake tin lined with baking paper, a small saucer of butter and a wooden spoon, the bowl of batter behind.
Close-up of a round cake tin on the worktop: her fingers rub a little soft butter round the inside with a small piece of paper.
beats.move: Her fingers rub the butter round slowly; the tin stays still.

beats.shot: Close-up of the round cake tin: her hand spoons thick pale batter into it and spreads it into a first layer.
beats.move: The batter spreads slowly into a smooth layer under the back of the spoon.

beats.shot: Top-down close-up of the round tin with a first layer of batter: her fingers lay pale cinnamon apple slices over it in a neat circle.
beats.move: Her fingers lay slice after slice in a slow circle; each slice stays where it lies.

beats.shot: Top-down close-up of the round tin: a second layer of thick batter is spooned over the apple slices.
beats.move: The batter drops slowly in spoonfuls and her spoon spreads it level.

beats.shot: Top-down close-up of the round tin: a final layer of overlapping apple slices fanned in a ring on top of the batter.
beats.move: Her fingers set the last slices into the ring slowly.

beats.shot: Top-down close-up of the round cake tin filled with batter and fanned pale apple slices, on the oak worktop: her fingers, in a cream chunky-knit cardigan sleeve pushed up to the forearm, scatter brown sugar and a few small cubes of butter over the apple slices. A round tin, not a tray.
beats.move: Brown sugar falls slowly onto the apples; the tin stays still.

beats.shot: Close-up of the open oven door of the sage-green range: her hands in a faded quilted oven glove slide the filled cake tin onto the rack.
beats.move: She slides the tin in slowly and draws her hands back; the oven door stays open.

beats.shot: Close-up of the sage-green range with the oven door now closed: a kitchen timer on the worktop beside it, her finger turns its dial.
beats.move: Her finger turns the dial slowly and the timer starts to tick.

beats.shot: Ellie seen from the side at the window, head bowed, wiping her hands slowly on her olive linen apron while the range hums behind her.
beats.move: She wipes her hands slowly and looks out at the garden; the camera stays still.

beats.shot: Close-up of the small-paned kitchen window: late-afternoon sun on the glass jars on the sill, the walled garden beyond, a few red apples still in the tree.
beats.move: A little steam on the window pane slowly fades; nothing else moves and no one walks in.

beats.shot: Close-up of the old green tin with its lid back on and the recipe card leaning on it, a pale flour handprint on the oak worktop beside it, soft light.
Ellie seen from behind sitting on a wooden chair by the range with Pip the cat on her lap, her head bowed, waiting.
beats.move: She strokes Pip slowly with one hand; Pip's ear twitches once; the camera stays locked off.

beats.shot: Close-up of the closed oven door of the sage-green range with a small round glass window: warm orange light inside, nothing else visible.
beats.move: Only a thin wisp of steam curls up past the oven door; nothing else moves.

beats.shot: Close-up of the open oven of the sage-green range: the apple cake in its round tin, risen and golden-brown with browned apple slices on top, a skewer in her hand being slid into the centre.
beats.move: She pulls the skewer out slowly and it comes out clean; a little steam drifts out of the oven.

beats.shot: Wide view of the round oak table by the kitchen window in low late-afternoon sun, the walled garden outside, a wire cooling rack with a whole golden-brown apple cake on it, nobody in the frame.
Close-up of her hands in cream knit sleeves, in a quilted oven glove, lifting the golden-brown apple cake out of its tin onto a wire rack on the worktop.
beats.move: She lifts the cake slowly onto the rack and a thin wisp of steam rises from it.

beats.shot: Top-down close-up of the apple cake on the wire rack: golden-brown top with fanned browned apple slices and dark sugar crust; her hand dusts icing sugar over it through a small sieve.
beats.move: Icing sugar falls slowly in a fine white cloud and settles on the cake.

beats.shot: Close-up of the round oak table by the window: her hands in cream knit sleeves set down a white plate and a small fork on a linen napkin.
beats.move: She sets the plate down slowly and straightens the fork; the light stays steady.

beats.shot: Close-up of a slice of apple cake being lifted with a cake slice from the cake on the table: a golden crumb with pale apple layers, steam rising.
beats.move: The slice lifts slowly away and a little steam rises from the cut cake.

beats.shot: Top-down view of the round oak table by the window in low sun: a wedge of warm apple cake on a white plate showing its apple layers, the rest of the cake on the cooling rack, a cup of tea, the old green tin with the recipe card leaning on it.
Ellie seen from behind and a little to the side, sitting down at the round oak table by the window, the autumn garden outside.
beats.move: She sits down slowly and pulls her chair in; the window light stays still; the camera stays locked off.

beats.shot: Close-up of the plate of apple cake: a fork presses down and breaks off a corner of the warm cake.
beats.move: The fork lifts slowly out of the cake with a soft crumbly sound; steam rises.

beats.shot: Close-up of the old recipe card leaning against the green tin on the table, sun across it; her fingertip touches the corner stain.
beats.move: Her fingertip rests on the stain, then draws slowly away; the card stays still.

beats.shot: Close-up of Pip the cat curled on the second wooden chair at the table, the low sun on his fur.
beats.move: Pip breathes slowly and his ear twitches once; nothing else moves.

beats.shot: Ellie seen from behind at the table by the window, holding a warm cup of tea in both hands, the red apples in the tree outside.
beats.move: She lifts the cup slowly and a thin wisp of steam rises; the window stays still; the camera stays locked off.

beats.shot: Close-up of the table after: an empty white plate with a few crumbs and a fork, the cup of tea, the recipe card on the green tin, low sun.
Wide view of the thatched cottage window from the walled garden in low sun, the red apples in the bare apple tree in the foreground, nobody outside.
beats.move: Only the branches sway a little in the breeze; nobody walks in; the camera stays still.

beats.shot: Ellie seen from behind standing at the kitchen window, the recipe card in one hand held against the glass light, the garden outside.
beats.move: She lowers the card slowly to her chest; the window stays still; the camera stays locked off.

teaser.text: I picked up the windfalls this morning. By tea time they were grandmother's apple cake.

short.text: grandmother's apple cake, from the card to the table
